hook.say: Europe's ten highest mountains, ranked. Mont Blanc only just makes the list!

outro.say: Does the Caucasus count as Europe? Comment below!

items.name: Mont Blanc
items.say: Number ten: Mont Blanc, the top of the Alps. 4807 meters.
items.cap: Number ten: Mont Blanc, the top of the Alps. 4,807 meters.

items.name: Tetnuldi
items.fact: A ski resort on its slopes
items.say: Nine: Tet-nool-dee, with a ski resort on its slopes. 4858 meters.
items.cap: Nine: Tetnuldi, with a ski resort on its slopes. 4,858 meters.

items.name: Gistola
items.say: Eight: Ghistola, just 2 meters higher. 4860 meters.
items.cap: Eight: Gistola, just 2 meters higher. 4,860 meters.

items.name: Katyn-Tau
items.fact: On the Bezengi Wall of ice
items.say: Seven: Kah-tin-Tao, on the Bezengi Wall of ice. 4979 meters.
items.cap: Seven: Katyn-Tau, on the Bezengi Wall of ice. 4,979 meters.

items.name: Mount Kazbek
items.say: Six: Mount Kahzbeck, a dormant volcano. 5054 meters.
items.cap: Six: Mount Kazbek, a dormant volcano. 5,054 meters.

items.name: Janga
items.say: Five: Jahnga, the heart of the Bezengi Wall. 5085 meters.
items.cap: Five: Janga, the heart of the Bezengi Wall. 5,085 meters.

items.name: Koshtan-Tau
items.fact: A steep pyramid of rock and ice
items.say: Four: Koshtahn-Tao, a steep pyramid of rock and ice. 5151 meters.
items.cap: Four: Koshtan-Tau, a steep pyramid of rock and ice. 5,151 meters.

items.name: Shkhara
items.say: Three: Schkahra, the roof of Georgia. 5193 meters.
items.cap: Three: Shkhara, the roof of Georgia. 5,193 meters.

items.name: Dykh-Tau
items.say: Two: Deekh-Tao, Russia's second highest peak. 5205 meters.
items.cap: Two: Dykh-Tau, Russia's second highest peak. 5,205 meters.

items.name: Mount Elbrus
items.say: And number one: Mount Elbrooss! 5642 meters, a sleeping volcano and the roof of Europe.
items.cap: And number one: Mount Elbrus! 5,642 meters, a sleeping volcano and the roof of Europe.
